session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Identifier of the active debug session to control.

action.title: Action
action.description: Control action to perform: continue | stepOver | stepIn | stepOut | stop.

file.title: File
file.description: Node-relative file name the breakpoint is set in, e.g. "main.lua" / "mapping.lua".

line.title: Line

breakpoints.title: Breakpoints
breakpoints.description: Optional updated set of breakpoints to apply before performing the action.
